purpose: Phase-8A controlled re-sensitization model. Re-sensitization is the recovery of treatment sensitivity through an EXPLICIT transition (never assumed). Persistent resistance is NOT assumed irreversible, and acquired resistance does NOT always resolve - profile-specific rules decide. Ordinal states + triggers. Schematic; no real recovery time (NOT_REPORTED).

coefficient_policy.valid_range: sensitivity_recovery in [0,1] (additive, bounded restoration of treatment sensitivity)
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = full schematic recovery to baseline sensitivity the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: general reversibility biology applied predictively (per-profile reversal rules)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: recovery reduces the acquired/adaptive sensitivity-reduction through a bounded adapter; only via an explicit re-sensitization transition.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No measured recovery time or reversion rate (all NOT_REPORTED).

not_observed.meaning: Prior resistance present; no reversal observed.

rules.requires_prior_resistance: Re-sensitization requires a prior tolerant/adaptive/acquired state; validation rejects re-sensitization without prior resistance.
rules.explicit_transition_only: Sensitivity recovery occurs only through a recorded re-sensitization transition, never implicitly.
